### `ReservesTrack(bool isMobile)`

Whether the drawer occupies an in-flow grid track (not floating). A push drawer keeps its track even when closed -- at zero width -- so the track count stays stable and the width can animate.
Returns: `bool`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `isMobile` | `bool` | — |
